Aim_Off_0.tip: Keep your shooting elbow tucked under the ball so it flies straight.

Aim_Off_1.tip: Line your arm up with the basket before releasing for a straight shot.

Aim_Off_2.tip: Point your fingers straight at the rim when letting go of the ball.

Arc_Too_Flat_2.tip: Aim high above the rim so the ball drops softly into the basket.

Jerky_Motion_0.tip: Keep your arm moving smoothly without pausing before you release the ball.
Jerky_Motion_0.query: continuous unbroken motion, do not pause the ball at the forehead

Jerky_Motion_1.tip: Relax your shoulder and arm so your shooting motion stays smooth.
